Hi everyone, I am from the Philippines married to an Israeli with a child now a toddler, planning to visit again this summer and celebrate holidays in Israel purely for vacation. The child is with an Israeli passport, traveled already last year to Israel. We haven't opened any file. My concern is, last year we were held at the border,after long hours of waiting for the io interview plus the exhaustion and empty formula milk for the baby coz the extra was in the luggage, and extensive interrogation we were finally allowed to enter and Im afraid It will happen again.
Is there a way to get an entry permit? Or any idea what to do? Thank youuuuu 💓
